predecessor.prior_narrow_support: CAS-style update conflict detection supported; ambiguous retry reconciliation unproven

public_source.title: REST API endpoints for repository contents
observations: GET repository content returns 200 with file content and a file/blob sha, and 404 when the requested resource is not found.
Create-or-update uses PUT on the deterministic repository path; update requires the sha of the blob being replaced.
Create-or-update documents 200/201 success plus 409 Conflict and 422 validation outcomes.
The documented Contents contract exposes no idempotency-key or replay-token parameter for create-or-update requests.

tested_scope: Documentation-grounded state-machine analysis of retry-after-unknown-outcome for one deterministic GitHub Contents file path. No live fault injection, no parallel writes, no scheduler mutation, no checker rerun, no approval test, no plan/quota test, no cost test, and no 18-role coverage test were performed.

unknown_outcome_then_get_exact_desired.limit: This establishes current target-state equality, not unique attribution of the earlier ambiguous request or exactly-once commit history.

unknown_create_then_get_404.reason: A 404 is only a current-state observation. It does not prove the ambiguous create can no longer commit, nor exclude create-then-delete/intervening-history cases. Retrying could therefore race or repeat an earlier effect.

unknown_update_then_get_original_preimag.reason: The same original blob can reappear after an intervening commit/revert. A retry bound only to that blob sha can then succeed while failing to prove the first ambiguous update never committed, so exactly-once effect history is not established.

finding.reasoning: Deterministic-path GET plus exact bytes/blob identity is sufficient to avoid a duplicate retry when the desired target state is already visible, and different content can be treated as conflict. It is not sufficient to authorize a retry when the path is absent or has returned to the original preimage: those observations do not prove the ambiguous first write never committed or can no longer commit, and file-blob CAS does not encode intervening history. Under the evaluation role's duplicate/conflict hard gate, the candidate therefore remains unresolved until a stronger monotonic operation identity, transactional/history proof, or documented same-path collision guarantee closes the unknown-outcome gap.

scope_and_safety.acceptance_authority_revalidation_not_re: No positive Phase-1, worker, root, or candidate acceptance claim was made.

slice_result.hard_gate_resolution: remains_false; exact-target readback suppresses duplicate retry, but absence/preimage does not authorize exactly-once retry
